basic_info.description: Outer Parkside 3BD/3BA home just short blocks from Taraval Street MUNI lines, shops, restaurants, Sunset Blvd transit, and Ocean Beach. Close to top-rated public and private schools including S.I. High, A.P. Giannini, Sunset Elementary, Robert Stevenson Elementary, and Ulloa Elementary. This charming English entrance home was horizontally expanded in the late '70s, offering a spacious and flexible floor plan. The upper level features a bright living room with original fireplace, open dining area, and a kitchen with breakfast counters that flows into a large family room or office (converted from the original 2nd bedroom). Also on this level are a full bath with separate tub and shower, a front bedroom with sunny southern exposure, and a rear primary suite with full bath. Interior stairs connect to a lower level with a large 3rd bedroom, 3rd bath, wet bar, and private entrance through the garage. The expansive tandem garage fits 2 cars with room for storage or future expansion. Landscaped front and rear yards include a sunny deck and kids' playhouse - perfect for outdoor enjoyment.
